text:
Maya L: Heads-up — we've published Data Retention Policy v2 in the handbook. TL;DR: default retention for user logs reduced from 24 months -> 12 months; interview recordings and sales demos are excluded unless explicitly approved. Please read: https://handbook.redwood.com/policies/data-retention :link:

Jamie R: Thanks — where's the ack flow? Do managers need to track team-level consent?

Owen K: Also, does this apply to contractor S3 buckets we host?

Maya L: Manager ack required for people on your team by EOD Apr 3. Contractors included unless contract has stricter terms. We added an exception flow for recordings — fill the form, managers + legal sign-off.

Priya S: can you paste the exception form link?

Maya L: Sure — form is https://forms.redwood.com/retention-exception — fields: project, owner, data types, retention requested, justification. Quick snippet for managers to approve: `Approve -> add to sheet -> notify people-ops`

Legal - Sam: FYI, for EU data subject requests we should avoid blanket approvals. I'll review any exceptions flagged with `EU` tag

Jamie R: I'll update the team handbook page and send a calendar reminder. tagging @people-ops-bot to schedule the compliance training session.

people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — Compliance training: Data Retention v2 Q&A, Thu Apr 4, 11:00 PDT. RSVP: https://events.redwood.com/retention-qna (auto-reminder 24h)

Irene (contractor): Quick question — is video interview data considered 'sales demo' or 'product feedback'? We have a bunch.

Owen K: I'd like to request an exception for interview videos used for hiring calibration — will submit form.

Maya L: Thanks — Planning to maintain an exception tracker in the sheet. For managers: export your team list, paste -> mark acked. Template: https://docs.redwood.com/templates/retention-ack-template.xlsx

Priya S: Noted. Can we get an automated report of outstanding acks per manager?

people-ops-bot: Yes — weekly digest will be posted to #people-ops and sent to each manager. First digest: Mon Apr 8.

Legal - Sam: Please loop me in on any exceptions flagged for EU/UK data.

Maya L: :thumbsup: thanks all.
